description: This Java class provides a service for exporting data tables in JSON format within the Finferact project. It retrieves report data, serializes it to JSON, and returns it as an HTTP response.

classes.name: JsonDatatableReportExportService
classes.description: A Spring service class that implements report exporting in JSON format, supporting different serialization based on query parameters.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports report data as JSON response, serializing the data either as a generic JSON or using a custom serializer, based on input parameters.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks whether the service supports a given export type (JSON or PRETTY_JSON).

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports report data to a JSON response, serializing it appropriately based on query parameters.

methods.name: supports
